parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production initializer in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). Extracting the shared 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.init' to a common location would couple production DebugPanel code to a demonstration fixture, which is the canonical anti-pattern described by the restraint rule. The duplication is expected: the sample app independently replicates the display-link machinery for self-contained demonstration purposes.
